lines.text: It's receipts in a pocket, photos in a chat, plans in a drawer, and a spreadsheet nobody trusts.
Send a receipt on WhatsApp. It's read, checked, and filed to its project.
Site photos are dated and kept, week by week.
Plans and permits wait in folders, right where you left them.
And everyone gets the right say.
The money, the site, the paperwork and the people, in one calm place.
